notes: Poets&Quants' report on the Class of 2027, read on 2026-09-27, labels both GMAT averages: "Average GMAT 10th Edition 731" and "Average GMAT Focus 681", with average GRE 163 Quant and 160 Verbal, average GPA 3.43, 379 students from 3,923 applications, a 30 percent acceptance rate, 39 percent women and 40 percent international. It prints no work experience figure, so the 5.8 years once recorded was removed (INC-0154). FT 2026 full-time MBA rank could not be verified and is nulled. QS 2026 rank not seen and nulled. michiganross.umich.edu is behind a Cloudflare bot challenge that returned 403 to every fetch attempt (WebFetch, curl, and headless Chromium all blocked), so no Ross field could be read on an official page. The tuition_usd (81152, 2025-26 non-resident) was sourced to the official Ross tuition page in a prior session and is kept unchanged. Ross does publish a Class of 2027 profile (news item: Ambition in Action) and a 2025 full-time MBA career report on its site; retry these URLs from a network that passes the Cloudflare challenge.
